name: mufasal
description: MUFASAL - Custom Tailored Precision Platform for Men's Tailoring & Children's Clothing

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd apps/web && npm run lint" "cd services/api && npm run lint"
scripts.db:migrate: cd services/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd services/api && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm install && cd packages/shared && npm install && cd ../../services/api && npm install && cd ../../apps/web && npm install && cd ../../apps/mobile && npm install
